user.title: Zero Grid Controller — Grid Sensors
user.description: Add the sensors that measure how much power is drawn from and delivered to the grid. Add PV arrays and batteries as subentries after setup.

data.name: Integration name
data.grid_import_sensors: Grid import sensors (power drawn from grid)
data.grid_export_sensors: Grid export sensors (power delivered to grid, optional)

data_description.deadband_w: Grid error below this value is ignored. Prevents unnecessary setpoint changes when already close to zero.
data_description.ewm_alpha: Smoothing factor for the grid signal (0.05 = heavy smoothing, 1.0 = no filter).
data_description.aggressiveness: Controls how aggressively PID gains are set after calibration.

data.setpoint_entity: Entity that sets the power limit

data_description.power_sensor_entity: Per-array power sensor used for 30% → 20% midpoint calibration.
data_description.setpoint_min: The lowest value the controller will ever write (e.g. 0 % or 0 W).
data_description.setpoint_max: The highest value — full output. Calibration uses this range to measure inverter gain.

switch_params.title: Switch control parameters
switch_params.description: Configure the grid power thresholds for turning this switch on and off.

data_description.switch_on_threshold_w: The switch turns on when grid import exceeds this value.
data_description.switch_off_threshold_w: The switch turns off when grid export exceeds this value.
data_description.switch_debounce_s: Minimum seconds between state changes to prevent rapid toggling.

grid_sensor_unavailable.title: Grid sensor unavailable
grid_sensor_unavailable.description: The configured grid power sensor(s) are unavailable. Zero Grid Controller cannot measure grid power and has entered safe state. Check that your grid sensors are online and reporting valid states.
